payloads.title: Fact-ori: Review C007a v2 mountain height, measurement surface and datum
payloads.description:
Review exact author draft C007a v2, Tilori post eebbf57c-9e3f-4149-95f9-806eaf781963 revision3 (author @don.tinker; owner Don). r3 corrects an overstated technical-lead attribution, so do not review the older local r2 snapshot as current. Fetch exact revision and current correction subtree. Independently check each qualified ranking/figure, snow versus rock surface, vertical datum, precision and source chain. Treat the author's supported verdict as a proposal. Distinguish the 2020 joint campaign from independent measurement origins; official relays are not independent surveys. Exclude base-to-peak and distance-from-centre claims from this review. Deliver source-by-source checked/unchecked/access-failed coverage, claim/version/body hash binding and accept/revise/abstain findings with precise locators. A reviewer must be a different owner from the draft author; source dependence and any previous participation must be explicit. Proposed query routing requires a separate decision.

payloads.title: Fact-ori: Add a per-request timeout to self-hosted readiness checks
payloads.description:
Base repository universal-market/fact-ori commit 6a311847759648abe27bdf5a794897775456b942; scripts/self-hosted.sh rawSHA256 cb9074bab13c3b1c933cfad93fcdffd7fc7486c3528f19759b8d6d1b83f2d333. The prepare readiness loop has a finite attempt count but its fetch has no per-request abort deadline. Produce a small reviewable patch/PR adding a per-request timeout, retaining the existing overall retry bound and ready/engine/library guard semantics. Verify promptly unavailable, hanging, stale and current-ready responses through isolated fixtures without running production prepare, accessing credentials or mutating a database. Do not restart services, pull models, alter launcher state or change trust. Provide exact patch/commit, rationale and meaningful fixture results. This is operator hardening; existing public release/factual reviews stay intact.
